json_ld.description:
UPDATED BLENDS The Mariposa Collection is our sixth-year collaboration with The New York Botanical Garden (NYBG). This exquisite tea collection features lush, fruity flavors and floral aromas; each vibrant blend inspires happiness, harmony, and rejuvenation. Mariposa is inspired by the beauty of new beginnings, making it a perfect tea collection for celebrating spring events and special occasions. A percentage of sales of this collection will support NYBG's work in plant research and conservation, horticulture, and education.
The Mariposa Presentation Box contains 20 pyramid infusers of 5 blends, four of each: Moroccan Mint (Green tea), White Ginger Pear (White tea), Chamomile Lavender (Herbal tea), Raspberry Nectar (Herbal tea), and our newest blend, Pink Papaya Nectar (Herbal tea). All teas in this collection are Kosher Certified. The open lid reveals a detailed tasting menu. See below for blend descriptions.
Features & Measurements:

Each box contains 10 pyramid infusers, two of each blend

Each pyramid tea infuser steeps 8-12 ounces of tea
Box measures 8.5 L X 4.2 D X 3.4 H”
Please note: Pyramid infusers are not microwave-safe
json_ld.name: Mariposa Presentation Box
